tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.

A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Où est-ce que Nguyen travaille ?” The first tile is the question word (qui, qu'est-ce que, où, quand, comment, combien, pourquoi, quel); the verb tile is the infinitive.
In the question, put the question word first, then est-ce que (qu'est-ce que when you ask about a thing), then the subject and the verb: Quand est-ce que le cours commence ?
B hears the question and answers with the information asked for (a place, a time, a number, a reason). The subject tile says who; je becomes j' before a vowel.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
